method: stratified environment bootstrap: resample environments within each family with replacement, then equal-family macro; 5000 draws; seed 20260715; paired model/split-half draws (same resampled indices per family per draw)
description: Empirical label-reproduction headroom = split-half reproducibility minus current best model. This is an empirical gap, NOT a mathematical upper bound; the fixed-label hard ceiling remains 100%.

split_half.note: Per-environment split-half accuracies ARE available in the split_half JSON (environments[].views.benchmark_eligible.median_split_half.three_choice_accuracy), so a proper environment-level stratified bootstrap was computed. Family grouping taken from each environment's 'family' field in the same file.

headroom.pairing: paired: within each draw, the same resampled environment indices are used for both current_model and split_half within every family (environments are matched 1:1 by experiment_id across the two sources)
headroom.note: empirical label-reproduction headroom, not a fixed-label mathematical upper bound

bootstrap_details.percentile_method: linear interpolation between closest ranks (numpy 'linear' default)
bootstrap_details.prng: python random.Random(20260715), rng.randrange per resampled index
